patch_description: Implements the recommended controlled mutation: a constant-velocity Kalman prefilter with NIS-driven process noise where `q_base = 0.02 * r` and the multiplier is hard-capped at 4× (previously up to 51×), so noise can no longer flood the velocity state — the likely driver of the 165.8 slope changes / 125.8 false reversals. The Kalman output is followed by the leading-edge exponentially-weighted regression (zero group delay, preserving the excellent lag 0.31 / responsiveness 0.76 of the current program), then a slope-EMA trend-lock and a stronger locally-adaptive hysteresis snap (k=0.8, blend=0.75) to remove residual slope churn. This combination directly attacks slope_changes and false_reversals while keeping the responsiveness backbone validated in earlier gens.
